name: KLAS Research: Healthcare IT Research and Best in KLAS Landing Page
title: KLAS Research: Healthcare IT Research and Best in KLAS Landing Page
answer: This is the KLAS Research website landing page, published by KLAS Research. It describes a healthcare IT research organisation that gathers candid feedback from executives, physicians, nurses, IT professionals, administrators, payers and providers. The most useful point is that KLAS research and its annual Best in KLAS rankings come directly from people using IT solutions and services. It also states KLAS has provided insights since 1996 and offers free data access to healthcare professionals who share feedback.

sections.body: KLAS Research publishes this page. It is a website landing page for a healthcare IT research and insights organisation. The text says KLAS has provided insights for the healthcare IT industry since 1996. It describes research drawn from executives, physicians, nurses, IT professionals, administrators, providers and payers. It also describes free access for healthcare professionals who share feedback and paid memberships for vendors, payers, investors, government agencies and associations. The page includes a note about enabling JavaScript for a form. No publication date is stated in the source text.
sections.heading: What this source is

sections.body: KLAS Research says its mission is to improve the world's healthcare through insights, collaboration and transparency. Its insights come from thousands of healthcare professionals sharing their healthcare IT experiences. The text says all KLAS research comes directly from people using IT solutions and services, including executives, physicians, nurses, IT professionals and administrators. When healthcare professionals share feedback, they gain free access to live data, customer comments, healthcare IT market reports and more. Paid memberships are offered for vendors, payers, investors, government agencies and associations. The annual Best in KLAS report recognises software and services companies that excel in helping healthcare organisations accomplish the Quadruple Aim. All rankings are a direct result of feedback collected throughout the year from thousands of professionals at provider and payer organisations. The Best in KLAS awards celebrate the commitment and partnership provided by the healthcare IT industry's top vendors. KLAS says it has been providing accurate, honest and impartial insights for the healthcare IT industry since 1996. Its mission is to improve the world's healthcare by amplifying the voice of providers and payers. The scope of its research is constantly expanding to best fit market needs as technology becomes increasingly sophisticated. KLAS says it finds hard-to-get HIT data by building strong relationships with payer and provider friends in the industry. The page also asks users to enable JavaScript to complete a form and says website issues will be resolved as soon as possible.
sections.heading: What it says

sections.body: The text states KLAS has provided insights since 1996. It says insights come from thousands of healthcare professionals. It says all rankings in the annual Best in KLAS report are a direct result of feedback collected throughout the year from thousands of professionals at provider and payer organisations. It defines the Best in KLAS report as recognising software and services companies that excel in helping healthcare organisations accomplish the Quadruple Aim. It says healthcare professionals who share feedback gain free access to live data, customer comments and healthcare IT market reports, while paid memberships are for vendors, payers, investors, government agencies and associations. It gives no clinical AI vendor names, no clinical AI ratings and no numerical benchmarks.
sections.heading: Figures and claims worth noting

sections.body: A reader following AI in healthcare would use this source to understand the research model behind KLAS rankings, because the page says KLAS gathers feedback from providers and payers and bases its Best in KLAS rankings on that feedback. That matters if the reader wants to judge healthcare IT vendors by real-world provider experience, but the source text itself does not mention AI, clinical AI or any specific AI vendor. It only describes healthcare IT research in general. The page is therefore useful as background on KLAS's method and membership access, not as a source of AI-specific findings.
sections.heading: What it means for AI in Healthcare

sections.body: This is a landing page, not a research report or methodology paper. It does not name any vendors, products, clinical AI tools or ratings. It does not give dates for the Best in KLAS report or the research data. It promotes free access and paid memberships, so it has a commercial and membership recruitment purpose. The text is partial and high level, with no detailed findings, sample sizes or definitions beyond the Quadruple Aim reference. It also includes a website form notice, which is not substantive research content.
